name: file-shake
description: See which files are being edited, live: green for the file being changed, yellow for the files it references, shaking in proportion to activity.

virtualWorkspaces.description: File watching and import resolution need a real file system.

colors.description: Colour of the file being edited (Explorer decoration and File Shake view).
Colour of files referenced by the file being edited (Explorer decoration and File Shake view).

fileShake.enable.markdownDescription: Enable File Shake. When off, nothing is tracked, decorated or shown.

fileShake.enableAnimation.markdownDescription: Shake rows in the File Shake view. Colours, badges and the intensity meter are always shown. Animation is also disabled when your OS requests reduced motion.

fileShake.idleTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds without edits after which a file is considered idle (shaking stops and the intensity fades to zero).

fileShake.windowMs.markdownDescription: Length in milliseconds of the sliding window used to measure the edit rate.

fileShake.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum number of files shown at once (edited files first, then the most-referenced files).

fileShake.excludeGlobs.markdownDescription: Glob patterns (relative to the workspace folder) of files that are never tracked and never shown as references.

fileShake.colors.edited.markdownDescription: Colour of edited files in the File Shake view (for example `#3fb950`). Empty follows the theme colour. This setting affects the webview only; Explorer colours come from `workbench.colorCustomizations` keys `fileShake.editedForeground` / `fileShake.referencedForeground`.

fileShake.colors.referenced.markdownDescription: Colour of referenced files in the File Shake view (for example `#e3b341`). Empty follows the theme colour. This setting affects the webview only; Explorer colours come from `workbench.colorCustomizations` keys `fileShake.editedForeground` / `fileShake.referencedForeground`.

fileShake.sensitivity.markdownDescription: Multiplier for how strongly rows react to activity. Higher values reach full shake with fewer edits or references.

fileShake.showWhenIdle.markdownDescription: Keep idle files (and the files they reference) listed after activity stops, instead of removing them a few seconds after they go idle.

fileShake.decorateFolders.markdownDescription: Also tint the parent folders of active files in the native Explorer (a coloured name with a small dot).

fileShake.detectExternalEdits.markdownDescription: Track changes that do not come from typing in the focused editor (for example Claude Code, git, formatters, build tools) and label them `external`.

fileShake.maxFileSizeKb.markdownDescription: Files larger than this many kilobytes are tracked as edited but are not scanned for references.

fileShake.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the File Shake status bar item with the currently tracked file.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/webview/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --import tsx test/integration/runTest.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
